source_semantics.actor_grad_norm: clip_grad_norm_ returns global actor L2 norm BEFORE threshold .5 clipping; top-level is last accepted actor minibatch only
source_semantics.critic_mse_and_ev: post-update in-sample values vs current rollout GAE return targets, valid decisions only; no independent value generalization measure
source_semantics.entropy: sum of active latent Gaussian differential entropy; negative valid; different active dimension counts incomparable directly
source_semantics.advantage_std: mean of per-update valid-decision std; combined_normalized std near1 by construction, not absence of raw-signal differences
source_semantics.kl: analytic diagonal Gaussian KL averaged over all valid rollout decisions after each candidate minibatch; actor/Adam restored on rejected steps
source_semantics.lr: used_lr is current accepted update actual LR; next_lr may recover only for next update; retry can cancel recovery before use
